authority: owner assessment 2026-09-19 and 2026-09-21: native state geometry with five predeclared verdicts and no modifications; retention-first ordering. Authorized in manifests/todo.json as SCI-EI-NATIVE-STATE-1
diagnostic_measures: maximum v reached between resets per class
u at matched I_net per class
conditional spike probability versus I_net per class
PV/VIP trajectories at the same network phases as SST spikes

principal_delta: none: measurement only. If the retention re-run below executes, its only delta from the sealed intact arm is recording
question: what state-space event permits SST to repeatedly spike while PV/VIP almost never cross their spike/reset boundary under the same realized circuit
required_variables: v_i(t), u_i(t), I_net,i(t) per representative cell (engine-native dt 0.1 ms)
s_i(t) per representative cell plus full-population 1 ms spike trains for phase alignment
I_E,i(t) and I_I,i(t) per source ONLY if an engine output carries them; established absent, so not required
retention_criterion: per class (E, PV, SST, VIP), at least one representative cell with per-neuron v, u, total current and spikes on a common clock spanning spike-proximal and non-spiking states, sufficient to construct (v_i, u_i, I_net,i)(t) and estimate P(s_i=1|v_i, u_i, I_net,i, class). Group means do not satisfy this for any class

retention_rerun.changes: recording only: retain per-neuron v, u, total current and spikes at engine dt for at least one representative cell per class across the full run, plus full-population 1 ms spike trains; identical construction, regime, seed, duration, stimulus
retention_rerun.forbidden: any tonic, connectivity, weight or parameter change; any per-source-current demand the engine cannot emit
retention_rerun.reason: the inventory concludes retention fails the criterion above

runs.out: this spec (retention fails: re-run specified, not yet executed)

stop_condition: measurement only. One evaluation (or the single authorized retention re-run), then STOP; no parameter is changed, nothing is calibrated, no repair axis is manufactured

verdicts.DYNAMIC_RECRUITMENT_DEFICIT: PV/VIP rarely receive threshold-capable current excursions

verdicts.SST_STATE_ADVANTAGE: SST-specific state trajectory explains its high firing
